title: Dot product identity for the small-bias generator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\ell$ be a nonzero natural number, let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $r,s$ belong to the degree-$\ell$ extension field of $\mathbb F_2$. The dot product of $\gamma$ with the small-bias generator evaluated at $r,s$ equals the dot product of the encoding of the polynomial with coefficients $\gamma$ evaluated at $r$ and the encoding of $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $r,s$ belong to the degree-$\ell$ extension field of $\mathbb F_2$
